verifiedCapabilities.label: Strategy Builder
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Search thousands of rule combinations on the market you pick, with the costs and rules you set.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Workflows and robustness checks
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Put a strategy through ordered steps, unattended, and see why strategies drop out.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Results
verifiedCapabilities.summary: See how a strategy really traded, with a plain verdict that says so when it's weak.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Portfolio
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Combine your saved strategies and see their results together.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Charts
verifiedCapabilities.summary: A full charting workspace on real market data, with indicators, drawings and your own Pine scripts.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Order flow and profiles
verifiedCapabilities.summary: See what traded inside each bar, recorded from the exchange's public feed.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Apollo assistant
verifiedCapabilities.summary: An assistant beside your work that turns an idea into a strategy you can test. You confirm every change.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Models
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Machine-learning research on your saved markets or a strategy's trades, judged on data held out from the fit.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Journal
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Review executions, research results, routines and decisions in one place, kept on your PC.

verifiedCapabilities.label: Market data and import

verifiedCapabilities.label: Exports
verifiedCapabilities.summary: Take a strategy to your platform, or get a clear reason why it can't match.
